The rule this corpus enforces: promotion of shared routing code NEVER changes signed geometry -- a replay must reproduce these bytes (or re-verify these gates) before and after every routekit phase.

windows_note: run every gate/replay with PYTHONUTF8=1 -- 41 xt011 gates fail under cp1252 (scripts open files without encoding='utf-8').
